verdict.rationale: PagerDuty has a well-documented public REST API and Events API v2 with versioning, plus V3 webhooks, allowing AI-native agents/systems to programmatically create, trigger, acknowledge, and resolve incidents and manage configuration; runtime probes confirm these endpoints are live and functioning as documented. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer testimonials specifically validating AI-agent-driven API usage beyond vendor docs and probes.
